rationale: The workflow already contains a Gradle dependency cache (actions/cache@v4 caching ~/.gradle/caches and ~/.gradle/wrapper, keyed by runner.os and hashFiles of **/*.gradle* and gradle-wrapper.properties), which is exactly the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE optimization supported by measured experiment evidence (e.g., experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200 reported ~20% elapsed savings for a Gradle cache). Because an equivalent cache already exists, the pattern contraindication "An equivalent cache already exists" applies, so re-adding it would be redundant and would not preserve a meaningful change. No other evidence-supported pattern fits: there is no matrix (fail-fast/failed-job-first not applicable), no schedule (fail-schedule/idle-schedule not applicable), it is Gradle not Bazel, and change-filter or custom-timeout changes would require required-check and duration data that is not available, risking required-check coverage or false timeout failures.
